How Can We Help?

Common Questions

Reservations & Check-in

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is until 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability and may incur additional charges.

What is your cancellation policy?

Our standard policy allows free cancellation up to 48 hours before the check-in date. For non-refundable rates or special event dates, different policies may apply.

Do you require a security deposit?

Yes, a valid government-issued photo ID and a small security deposit (refundable at check-out) are required upon arrival.

Rooms & Amenities

Is Wi-Fi available in the rooms?

Yes, we provide complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in all our rooms and public areas.

Are your rooms air-conditioned?

Absolutely. All our room types (Deluxe and Executive) are equipped with high-performance air-conditioning systems.

Do you provide extra beds?

Yes, extra beds can be provided in our rooms for an additional charge. Our rooms can accommodate up to 5 guests total with extra bedding.

Dining & Facilities

Do you have a restaurant on-site?

Yes, "Curry, Wok & Waves" is our multi-cuisine restaurant located on the first floor, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

Is the swimming pool accessible to all guests?

Yes, our swimming pool is open to all in-house guests from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily.

Do you offer airport transfers?

Yes, we can arrange airport transfers for an additional fee. Please contact our travel desk 24 hours in advance.

Location & Nearby

How far is Yogi Tree Resort from Morjim Beach?

We are situated just a short 700-meter walk from the beautiful Morjim Beach.

Are there shops and cafes nearby?

Yes, Morjim is a vibrant area with numerous local shops, cafes, and shacks within walking distance of the resort.

Still Have Questions?

If you can't find what you're looking for, our friendly front desk team is available 24/7 to assist you.
